title: List rule versions and summarize the active rule set
description: Publish classify.rule.list and classify.rule-set.active.get as bounded owner-local queries over immutable rule and activation history. Implements G7 and UC-CLASSIFY-008.
rationale: The shipped status query can inspect a known rule version but cannot discover the catalogue or summarize the current authority from an empty-state-safe public entry point.
story_want: discover every rule version and the active rule-set authority
story_so_that: I can safely decide what to validate, activate, retire, or inspect
acceptance_criteria: Given rule versions exist and pageSize from 1 through 500, when classify.rule.list is invoked, then it returns a deterministic page ordered by created timestamp then rule-version ID with total, filtered, returned, and continuation metadata.

Given filters for logical rule ID, lifecycle state, category ID, or active-rule-set membership, when rule.list succeeds, then every item satisfies every supplied filter and the first-page high-water mark plus filter fingerprint are bound into the opaque continuation.

Given a rule-list item, when it is returned, then it contains logical rule ID, immutable rule-version ID, prior version ID, category ID, current category display name, category lifecycle enum, normalization version, effective rule lifecycle state, active membership, broad-apply authority, provenance, scope hash, lifecycle timestamps, and canonical conditions only within the already-public closed predicate contract.

Given an active rule set, when classify.rule-set.active.get is invoked, then it returns ruleSetVersionId, broadApplyAllowed, activation and validation IDs, trusted gate receipt ID and fingerprint, normalization version, ordered activated rule-version IDs, lifecycle timestamps and status, activation epoch, and category ID, current display name, and lifecycle enum for every member category.
Given no active rule set exists, when rule-set.active.get is invoked, then it returns the typed not-found result and never fabricates an empty authority or accepts a caller-supplied authority flag.

Given an invalid, expired, cross-filter, cross-page-size, or high-water-mismatched rule continuation or impossible membership/lifecycle history, when a discovery query is invoked, then it returns a typed cursor or integrity error with no partial page.

Given either rule discovery operation succeeds or fails, when durable state and diagnostics are inspected, then no corpus path, raw validation row, source description, secret, owner free-text reason, or predicate token beyond the public rule predicate contract has been persisted or logged.
security_criteria: Rule predicates are disclosed only through the existing closed owner-local predicate contract; corpus rows, descriptions, private paths, and authority claims are never accepted or returned.
